hashes: digest = final engine state; streamHash = sampled tick stream (every 20); resultHash = ChallengeResult hash (challenge) or engine.snapshot() hash at match end (live/runner); calls = configure*/enable* order with 8-hex argument hashes

seeds.bindingRule: case i of its group uses seeds pool[i % 6] and pool[(i + 3) % 6] (2 seeds per case); roster = v20 golden liveRosters[seed]; blue players/lineup/loadout and build strategy standard as v20 live cases; red = STANDARD_OPP_TACTIC (no opponent team); no talent picks
seeds.bindingRed: follow-up group: RED side carries a binding through the balance-tool runner (runner.configure tactic argument); 6 arms x 2 seeds (pool[(i+1)%6], pool[(i+4)%6]); controls = v20:runner-standard-<seed> (red std)
